items.stem: Why must audit criteria be defined before testing begins?

options.text: Findings are only meaningful when measured against agreed, testable criteria
options.rationale: Correct: criteria give findings an objective reference point.

options.text: Criteria slow the audit down needlessly

options.rationale: The opposite: criteria enable meaningful testing.
They structure, not predetermine, the outcome.

items.explanation: Correct: criteria give findings an objective reference point.

items.stem: Which TWO properties strengthen an AI audit's credibility? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Independence of the auditor from the system's builders
options.rationale: Correct: independence reduces conflict of interest.

options.text: Traceable evidence linking findings to criteria
Omitting any limitations to look thorough

items.explanation: Correct: independence reduces conflict of interest.

items.stem: What should an audit report NOT claim?

options.text: That the audited system is free of all risk going forward
options.rationale: Correct: audits give point-in-time assurance, not a risk-free guarantee.

options.text: That findings are rated by severity
That management has responded to findings

items.explanation: Correct: audits give point-in-time assurance, not a risk-free guarantee.
